_doc: Named real places for the layout gates (rule R-STITCH, tools/bake/layout/gate.ts; MAP_REPAIR.md 'District frames and stitching', 'Pair gate'). Every pair of places of the centre block must keep its real bearing within 0.5 degrees and its real distance within 0.5% in the game. Positions are WGS84 degrees read from OpenStreetMap elements (the element is named in 'from'; a way or relation is given by the centre of its box), never from the projected map. Pilot places were read from the pilot stage extract (osmBase 2026-11-11T15:09:21Z, P1-007), the others by Overpass on 2026-11-11 (osmBase 16:34 to 16:52Z, P1-008). 'pilot': true marks a place the pilot centre outline must hold (tools/bake/layout/pilot.test.ts). Far block places are for the extent check and the far skyline; they take no part in the centre pair gate.
